A harness-global or TRANS_RO_RD range also carries trans_sh_any: its shadow facts at every AR state (those shadow bytes are the runtime's own, so no caller keeps them; the record fixes them). The callee's own window is excluded by decode_off_win. - the walk lemmas over trans_src_ok: trans_src_ok_rd (decode_rd_ok in every case), trans_src_ok_place (where the range lies: below alloc_ceiling, or in the machine stack), trans_src_ok_sub / decode_off_win_sub (a sub-range), trans_src_ok_view (a later memory of the walk's own runs), trans_src_ok_inner (an inner call state), trans_src_ok_acall / trans_src_ok_acall_g (across a donor callee, YCbq.v acall_kept, and across a G-form callee, lib/A/Prog/TransportGCg.v acall_kept_g), trans_src_ok_disj_own (apart from a callee's new side-stack frame); the shadow lemmas stack_zshadow_ra (the machine stack), decode_zshadow_ra (a zero-shadow range of the record), decode_rd_ok_fake_kept (a side-stack frame whose shadow is kept); the G facts inG_G_HARNESS_hull, G_HARNESS_gx_ok, G_HARNESS_gx_noerrno.
